entries.4cd06dfd37809242: This business manufactures and sells photomask-based semiconductor circuit design dimension measurement, defect review and analysis equipment, as well as A/D and D/A converters, electron guns and other units essential to semiconductor manufacturing equipment. A&D Company, Limited and HOLON Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell these products, and A&D Manufacturing Co., Ltd. manufactures them. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,114 million (down 9.6% year on year), and operating profit was ¥3,628 million (down 12.0% year on year). Following strong demand in previous periods, the business entered an adjustment phase this year and revenue declined. In addition, higher up-front investment to expand service operations also contributed to lower profit.
entries.5a3098aac757f904: This business manufactures and sells home blood pressure monitors, medical blood pressure monitors, vital sign monitors, precision scales, ultrasonic inhalers and other products. A&D Company, Limited manufactures and sells these products. In addition, in Japan A&D Manufacturing Co., Ltd. manufactures them. Overseas, Aiantoku Electronics (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. and A&D Vietnam Limited manufacture them, and A&D ENGINEERING, INC. and seven other companies sell them. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,667 million (up 10.5% year on year), and operating profit was ¥4,009 million (down 2.4% year on year). In Japan, revenue declined due to weak demand for medical weighing instruments and changes to the distribution flow for overseas products. In the Americas, revenue rose on higher results from large customers and the expansion of medical DX-compatible products and sales channels for health equipment. In Europe, yen-converted revenue increased due to changes to the distribution flow and the effects of exchange rates. Overall, revenue increased. Operating profit decreased due to higher costs from tariffs in the United States and the intensification of sales activities.

entries.97c65873521d4f83: This business manufactures and sells measurement and control and simulation systems, material testing machines, environmental measuring instruments, electronic balances, platform scales, indicators, load cells, foreign-matter inspection equipment and other products. A&D Company, Limited manufactures and sells these products. In Japan, Best Sokki Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells them, and A&D Manufacturing Co., Ltd. manufactures them. Overseas, A&D SCALES CO.,LTD. and Aiantoku Electronics (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. manufacture them, A&D ENGINEERING, INC. manufactures and sells them, and A&D KOREA Limited and six other companies sell them. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥31,545 million (up 2.9% year on year), and operating profit was ¥3,387 million (up 25.2% year on year). In Japan, firm demand for weighing instruments and large orders for DSP equipment contributed to higher revenue. In the Americas, revenue fell due to reduced capital investment and the effects of tariffs, both resulting from changes in policy and market conditions surrounding EVs. In Asia and Oceania, strong demand for weighing instruments in China and India outweighed weak demand in South Korea, and overall revenue increased.
